notes.title: Pens: Ballad of the Erasers 40% off sale
notes.content:
Have you enjoyed your time in [i]The Freeware Collection[/i]? Well, the story has not reached its conclusion just yet!

To celebrate the release of [i]Pens: The Freeware Collection[/i], for the next six days, you can purchase the [i]Pens[/i] series' first commercial release, [i]Pens: Ballad of the Erasers[/i] for 40% off!

All you need to do to snag this great bargain is click on the Steam link below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118330/Pens_Ballad_of_the_Erasers/
